title: Hearty Smoky Tunisian Bread Flatbread
description: A smoky and crunchy Tunisian dish featuring marinated bread, perfect for a monsoon day, with ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, mix the olive oil, minced garlic, and active dry yeast.
Add the warm water to the yeast mixture and stir to combine.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4-6 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
